en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large Neo‑Renaissance palace‑like building with elaborate roofline, balustrades, and sculptural decoration, set behind a formal garden with lawns, flowerbeds, and pathways. Another similar institutional building stands at the right, with a monument or column in the garden between them. The setting appears to be an academic or governmental complex in a Central European city. A small number "1127-20" is printed in white in the lower right corner; no other text is visible.
